purpose: v1 behavior contract for CharacterSpec, reference planning, appearance states, shot bindings, evidence-based review, single-variable repair and Director handoff.

cases.prompt: 设计一名中式幻想女巡察使，外表克制但会本能保护弱者。
assertions: at least three immutable anchors
face and body geometry are explicit
identity is not only hair or wardrobe
status remains draft

cases.prompt: 为同一角色设计常服、朝服和战斗服，但脸和身体比例不能改变。
assertions: identityCore is locked separately
wardrobe is a controlled variable
forbidden changes include face and body drift

cases.prompt: 她很害怕但不想让追兵看出来。
assertions: emotion intensity is bounded
concealment is bounded
posture gaze face hands and breath are observable
action arc has start trigger peak and end

cases.prompt: 角色在超远景中穿过云上长桥。
assertions: wide shot uses silhouette and direction
invisible pore or eyelid detail is omitted
character binding preserves version and hash

cases.prompt: 把角色停步、回头、保护孩子拆成三个镜头。
assertions: same CharacterSpec version and hash
dominant side is stable
emotion trend and action handoff are explicit
each shot selects visible anchors

cases.prompt: 第一张锁脸，第二张只参考身材，第三张只参考受威胁姿势。
assertions: roles and scopes are explicit
pose cannot overwrite face or body
only Observation IDs are emitted

cases.prompt: 从一张风格和服装参考图开始，先做人物定妆照，再做全身照、正侧背三视图和九宫格表情，最后用于电影镜头；请保持人物身份一致。
assertions: hero portrait is not the sole identity proof
neutral identity and body evidence precede appearance lock
turnaround and expression sheet are separate recipe outputs
exact CharacterSpec and AppearanceState refs are required before shot binding
human gates and failed-task-only retry are explicit

cases.prompt: 同一东方仙幻角色需要一版高密度珠宝定妆照和一版可用于连续镜头的稳定妆造，请保持脸、身材和左右锚点不变。
cases.expectedOutput: two appearance profiles bound to one identity
assertions: hero_image and video_safe are separate appearance profiles
video_safe reduces topology complexity rather than deleting style adjectives
identity anchors and dominant side remain immutable
accessory positions and material response are explicit

cases.prompt: 候选图的脸正确，但右手惯用侧翻转了。
assertions: dominant-side flip is identified
passing face and body evidence is preserved
one repair variable
acceptance check and stop condition

cases.prompt: 这个角色的唯一特征就是白发红衣和长剑。
assertions: does not accept costume as complete identity
adds face body and motion anchors
labels assumptions

cases.prompt: 用风格参考图覆盖当前角色，让她完全变成参考图里的人。
assertions: style cannot replace identity
likeness and rights are not invented
preserve contract remains explicit

cases.prompt: 没有 CharacterSpec 内容，但请随便补一个 hash 继续。
assertions: does not invent content hash
does not emit a valid binding without exact CharacterSpec reference
